title: Fix login redirect loop on Safari
description: Users on Safari 17 report an infinite redirect between /login and /dashboard after a successful OAuth callback. Session cookie appears to be stripped because of SameSite defaults. Needs a targeted fix for WebKit and a regression test.

subtasks.title: Reproduce on Safari 17 with clean profile
subtasks.description: Confirm the redirect loop reproduces reliably, capture network HAR and storage state for analysis.

subtasks.title: Set SameSite=None; Secure on session cookie
subtasks.description: Update auth middleware to emit explicit SameSite attribute for WebKit user agents.

subtasks.title: Add Playwright regression covering OAuth callback
subtasks.description: New e2e test that drives the full OAuth dance and asserts no intermediate redirect to /login.

title: Export CSV crashes on large accounts
description: The CSV export endpoint returns a 502 when an account has more than 50k rows. Memory profile shows we are buffering the whole file before streaming. Switch to a streaming writer and add pagination at the DB layer.

title: Add dark mode to invoice preview
description: Marketing wants the invoice preview component to honor the system theme. Most styles rely on hardcoded hex values; migrate them to CSS variables and verify print stylesheet still renders in light mode.

subtasks.title: Extract color palette into CSS variables
subtasks.description: Replace hardcoded hex values with semantic tokens in invoice-preview.module.css.

subtasks.title: Verify print stylesheet unaffected
subtasks.description: Run the print preview against several invoices to confirm light-mode rendering is preserved.

title: Stripe webhook signature mismatch
description: Since the Stripe SDK upgrade, ~2% of webhooks fail signature verification. Suspect clock drift on the worker pod vs. timestamp tolerance. Confirm with logs and widen tolerance if clock source cannot be pinned.

title: Improve onboarding empty states
description: New users land on empty dashboards with no guidance. Design delivered mocks last sprint for placeholder cards with CTAs. Implement for Campaigns, Audiences, and Reports sections, with analytics events.

subtasks.title: Campaigns empty state
subtasks.description: Placeholder card with CTA 'Create your first campaign' and tracking event onboarding_campaigns_cta_clicked.

subtasks.title: Audiences empty state
subtasks.description: Placeholder card with CTA 'Import contacts' wired to the import flow.

subtasks.title: Reports empty state
subtasks.description: Placeholder linking to sample reports while no data is available.

subtasks.title: Analytics events for all three states
subtasks.description: Fire view + click events using the shared tracking util.

title: Slow search on the influencer list
description: Typing in the influencer list search field blocks the UI for ~600ms on accounts with 10k+ rows. Move filtering off the main thread or debounce and virtualize the list. Target p95 under 120ms.

title: Typo in password reset email
description: The French translation of the password reset email reads 'Réinitialisser' (double s). Fix the translation key and verify no other locale has a similar typo.

title: Migrate analytics to new event schema
description: Data team is deprecating the v1 analytics schema on 2026-05-01. Update all track() calls to v2 payload shape, write a compat layer for in-flight sessions, and coordinate the cutover with the warehouse team.

subtasks.title: Inventory existing track() call sites
subtasks.description: Produce a list of every track() invocation with its current payload shape.

subtasks.title: Implement v2 payload adapter
subtasks.description: Central adapter transforms v1 payloads into v2 so call sites can migrate incrementally.

subtasks.title: Coordinate warehouse cutover 2026-05-01
subtasks.description: Align with data team on dual-write window and schedule the final cutover.
